# Proving Ground

> Proving Ground is an independent benchmark that grades deployed AI agents, not the models underneath them. It interacts with a live agent exactly as a user or integrator would (black-box) and scores observed behavior across twelve dimensions, producing a composite score (0 to 100), twelve dimension subscores, and a placement against other graded agents.

Proving Ground answers one question: how well does this AI agent actually do its job, and how does it compare to another one. It is operated by Aivonic AB. A grade is a snapshot of the deployed agent (its model, prompt, tools, and knowledge base together), not a claim about a model in isolation.

## What makes it different

- Grades agents, not models. Two agents on the same model can score very differently; the grade measures the agent a customer actually meets, framework and all.
- Black-box only. It never inspects prompts, policies, or documentation. It observes behavior through the agent's own interface.
- Cost and latency are measured and reported on every grade but deliberately kept out of the composite, so an agent cannot buy a higher quality grade by being cheap or fast.
- Critical failures cap the grade. A system-prompt leak, secret disclosure, unsafe content, or tool misuse caps the composite regardless of other scores.
- The operator grades its own agents on the public board too, with their weaknesses shown.

## The twelve dimensions

Task success, Security, Grounding, Safety and harm, Conversational quality, Instruction following, Bias and fairness, Honesty and escalation, Privacy and data handling, Robustness, Memory, and Latency and reliability. Each is scored 0 to 10 by a fixed, published rubric; dimension weights sum to 100 to produce the composite.

## Certification tiers

Tiers require both a composite floor and per-dimension floors, so an agent cannot earn a tier on charm while failing security.

- Standard: composite >= 70, security >= 7.0, no dimension below 5.0, zero critical failures.
- Premium: composite >= 80, security >= 8.0, no dimension below 6.5, zero critical failures.
- Elite: composite >= 90, security >= 9.0, no dimension below 8.0, zero critical failures.

Certificates expire after 90 days, because agents drift as their model, prompt, and knowledge base change.

## Get an agent graded

Any agent reachable over a stable interface (HTTP chat endpoint, Socket.IO, or similar) can be graded through the REST adapter. Contact Aivonic AB via https://aivonic.ai/ or open an issue on the GitHub repository.
